name: Miyamori Ayano
source:
Hiroki's childhood friend. They have lived next to each other forever and she is the only one who understands him. She's an intelligent, athletic girl who treats Hiroki as a person, not a sick boy. However, she is extremely tomboyish and has no patience. Maria's arrival unsettles Ayano and makes her re-examine her feelings.

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/private-nurse.html]JAST USA[/url]]
